## checkFieldReferences

Check an agent's or skill's custom field references. `POST /ai-field-references/check`

Check which custom field references of a Conversational Agent, a skill or a Run AI Assistant flow node will not work for the AI. Read-only; nothing is saved.

Send the editor's unsaved state in references (goal output bindings by custom_field_id, Context list keys, node outputs) and texts (skill or goal instructions; scanned best-effort for contact.custom.<key> tokens and field names). With agent_id the server also checks the agent's saved Context lists, instructions and (unless include_agent_skills is false) the goals of its skills; with skill_id that skill's saved goal and body. Unsaved state replaces the saved copy: everything sent for a skill:<id>/... path replaces that skill's saved references, and agent_context replaces the saved Context lists (null = all fields their AI access allows, [] = none).

```php
$result = $sendseven->aiAgents()->checkFieldReferences();
```

- Scopes: `automation:read`, `contacts:read`

| `$agentId` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$skillId` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$includeAgentSkills` | `?bool` | no | With agent_id: also check the goals of every skill linked to the agent. |
| `$agentContext` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no |  |
| `$references` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no |  |
| `$texts` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `FieldReferenceCheck`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/AI%20Agents/check_ai_field_references_api_v1_ai_field_references_check_post)

## getTrialGenerationQuota

Get Trial Ai Generation Quota. `GET /ai-generation/trial-quota`

AI builds the free trial still covers.

During the free trial, AI builds are free up to a fair-use number of builds (free_generations, shared by all builders). After that, a successful build of whatsapp_flow (WhatsApp Flows AI builder, generate and refine) or agent (AI Agent Builder "Create with AI" and the AI Flow Builder) uses credits_per_generation credits from the trial's shared AI-credit allowance (credits); failed builds use none. Per kind, used counts successful builds and remaining is how many more builds are possible (free builds left plus builds the remaining credits cover). Paid accounts are not capped.


## generateDraft

Generate Agent Draft. `POST /automation/agent-builder/generate`

## getConversationTimeline

Get Agent Conversation Timeline. `GET /automation/agents/{agent_id}/conversations/{conversation_id}/timeline`

One conversation as the agent handled it, oldest first: the messages (plain text, customer-visible messages only: no internal notes or system events) and every turn of this agent in it (same shape as /turns), so each customer message can be read next to the agent's reasoning, sources, tools and the reply it sent or the hand-off.

messages[].turn_id links a message to the turn it triggered (inbound) or that sent it (sender_kind agent_bot). The window starts context_before messages before the agent's first turn and ends up to 20 messages after its last turn; at most 300 messages and 200 turns are returned (truncated is then true).

```php
$result = $sendseven->aiAgents()->getConversationTimeline(agentId: 'agent_id', conversationId: 'conversation_id');
```

- Scopes: `automation:read`, `messages:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$agentId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$contextBefore` | `?int` | no | Messages shown before the agent's first turn in this conversation |

Returns `AgentConversationTimeline`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/AI%20Agents/get_agent_conversation_timeline_api_v1_automation_agents__agent_id__conversations__conversation_id__timeline_get)

## saveDraft

Save Agent Draft. `PUT /automation/agents/{agent_id}/draft`

Save (autosave) the agent draft. Fields left out keep their previous draft value; an explicit null resets a nullable field to its default (max_tool_calls, turn_timeout_ms, model_tier and source_footer_mode come back as their concrete default values; a null toggle or a null section / list keeps its value). Validated like the live endpoints (same 422 codes; where it can be determined the 422 also names the document field and editor section, and a located error without its own code is returned as {"code": "invalid_field", "message", "field", "section"}); new knowledge sources / channel rules get server ids. The live agent is not changed until POST /agents/{id}/publish. A draft identical to the live config is cleared. A save that changes nothing is a no-op: it never conflicts and does not move the revision.

Concurrent edits: send the revision of the document you edited as base_revision. If the agent changed since and your document differs from the current one, the call returns 409 draft_conflict with revision, revision_updated_at, revision_updated_by and the full current editor state in current. Without base_revision the last write wins.

```php
$result = $sendseven->aiAgents()->saveDraft(agentId: 'agent_id', document: []);
```

- Scopes: `automation:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$agentId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$document` | `array<string, mixed>` | yes |  |
| `$baseRevision` | `?int` | no |  |

Returns `AgentDraft`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/AI%20Agents/save_agent_draft_api_v1_automation_agents__agent_id__draft_put)

## publish

Publish Agent. `POST /automation/agents/{agent_id}/publish`

Publish the draft in one transaction. Changes made to the live agent since the draft was started are kept (three-way merge). Without a draft, a never-published agent is simply made live. 422 publish_blocked lists the blocking issues (name_missing, ai_disclosure_missing, goal_invalid, live_source_invalid, skill_missing).

Optional body {"base_revision": <int>}: when the agent changed since that revision, 409 draft_conflict (same body as PUT /agents/{id}/draft) and nothing is published. No body = publish whatever the current draft is.

```php
$result = $sendseven->aiAgents()->publish(agentId: 'agent_id');
```

- Scopes: `automation:update`

| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `AgentDraft`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/AI%20Agents/publish_agent_api_v1_automation_agents__agent_id__publish_post)

## test

Run one test-console turn. Nothing is sent to a customer (credits reports what a live turn would bill). The turn is recorded in the audit log with surface test. Rate limited to 20 turns per minute and 200 per hour per workspace (429 + Retry-After).
